models_evaluated: i-ROP deep learning autonomous ROP screening algorithm

links.outcome: Exam-level AUROC for mtmROP and type 1 ROP on two external sites, reported separately
links.effect: SUNDROP AUROC 0.896 (mtmROP) and 0.985 (type 1 ROP); AECS 0.920 and 0.982. Exam-level mtmROP sensitivity 83.5% (SUNDROP) and 80.8% (AECS).
links.quote: Examination-level AUROCs for mtmROP and type 1 ROP were 0.896 and 0.985, respectively, in the SUNDROP dataset and 0.920 and 0.982 in the AECS dataset.

screen.reason: Multinational retrospective external validation of an autonomous ROP screening deep learning algorithm across US and Indian telemedicine datasets without testing a deployment practice.
